results.original_prompt:
This part is a collection of multiple coaxial annular disks and a set of triangular prism wedges unioned into a single, disk-like assembly; every feature is an extruded planar sketch with a 31 unit extrusion thickness in the same direction. The main elements are two annular rings (each defined by an outer and inner circle) plus seven three-vertex or multi-vertex polygonal profiles that become prismatic wedges when extruded.

Setup: all sketches are created on the XY workplane; each sketch uses an origin offset from the global XY plane as listed below and then sketches are pushed/placed relative to that local origin before creating the geometry:
- Workplane XY origin at (-100, 0, -16)
- Workplane XY origin at (-62, 0, -16)
- Workplane XY origin at (-37, -27, -16)
- Workplane XY origin at (-19, 8, -16)
- Workplane XY origin at (-12, 23, -16)
- Workplane XY origin at (-1, -4, -16)
- Workplane XY origin at (11, 23, -16)
- Workplane XY origin at (-40, 23, -16)

Build description:
- On the workplane with origin (-100, 0, -16) push to point (100, 0) and draw two concentric circles at that pushed point with radii 100 (outer) and 81 (inner). Finalize that ring and extrude it 31 in the positive normal direction to create an annular disk.
- On the workplane with origin (-62, 0, -16) push to point (62, 0) and draw two concentric circles at that pushed point with radii 62 (outer) and 46 (inner). Finalize that ring and extrude it 31 in the positive normal direction to create a second annular disk.
- On the workplane with origin (-37, -27, -16) sketch a closed polygon using the points (0,0) → (36,23) → (18,36) → back to (0,0). Finalize and extrude that triangular profile 31 in the positive normal direction.
- On the workplane with origin (-19, 8, -16) sketch a closed polygon with vertices (0,0) → (18,-12) → (37,0) → (31,14) → (7,14) → back to (0,0). Finalize and extrude that five‑edge profile 31 in the positive normal direction.
- On the workplane with origin (-12, 23, -16) sketch a triangle (0,0) → (23,0) → (12,24) → back to (0,0). Finalize and extrude 31 in the positive normal direction.
- On the workplane with origin (-1, -4, -16) sketch a triangle (0,0) → (37,-25) → (19,12) → back to (0,0). Finalize and extrude 31 in the positive normal direction.
- On the workplane with origin (11, 23, -16) sketch a triangle (0,0) → (7,-14) → (29,0) → back to (0,0). Finalize and extrude 31 in the positive normal direction.
- On the workplane with origin (-40, 23, -16) sketch a triangle (0,0) → (21,-14) → (28,0) → back to (0,0). Finalize and extrude 31 in the positive normal direction.

After creating each extruded body, union it with the existing geometry so the final part is the single union of the two annular disks and the seven extruded polygonal prisms.
